verdict.rationale: A hands-on user reports Solid is small and easy to inject into other pages for data-viz widgets (solid-comm-8). Another user runs it on a largish web product (solid-comm-10). First-party docs back both ends: custom-element authoring, a small tree-shakable runtime, coexistence with native libraries, and full-app features like SSR, Stores and Context. However, the vendor never explicitly documents an incremental-adoption path. missing for 10: first-party documentation of mounting Solid into part of an existing page or app, guidance on migrating or scaling from an embedded widget to a full application.
